findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "01 / WORK, RECONNECTED" above "Good things happen when work flows.✳"; "COMPLETED RUNS" above "0"; "02 / THE POSSIBILITIES" above "A little less manual. A lot more momentu"; "THE NEXT CHAPTER IS YOURS." above "MAKE WORK FLOW."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: IBM Plex Mono — e.g. "THE AUTOMATION STUDIO", "LESS REPETITION. MORE POSSIBILITY.", "01 / WORK, RECONNECTED", "LIVE CANVAS"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / WORK, RECONNECTED", "01 / RECEIVE", "02 / PREPARE", "03 / DECIDE", "04 / DELIVER", "01"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 24 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "THE AUTOMATION STUDIO", "LESS REPETITION. MORE POSSIBILITY.", "01 / WORK, RECONNECTED", "LIVE CANVAS").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✳
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.aspect-square → linear-gradient(to left in oklab, rgb(168, 199, 230) 0%, rgb(40, 46, 52) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 7 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.demo-node.demo-node-0 → rgba(12, 14, 16, 0.376) 0px 6px 24px 0px | button.demo-node.demo-node-1 → rgba(12, 14, 16, 0.376) 0px 6px 24px 0px | button.demo-node.demo-node-2 → rgba(12, 14, 16, 0.376) 0px 6px 24px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 8 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | div.network-toolbar 1265px | div.network-bottom 1265px | section.tool-strip 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (5 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (IBM Plex Mono, DM Sans Variable, Manrope Variable).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 63 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 39px at 1440px. Widest offenders: div.absolute.aspect-square (+39px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Technology" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "should" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "give" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "you" (screen 5, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 83px at 768px. Widest offenders: div.absolute.aspect-square (+83px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Good things happen when work flows.✳" → 3 lines (6 words, 42px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
